decisions.reason: Although the accelerator program is somewhat peripheral to a machinery manufacturer, its home-page visibility and the possibility of explaining modest early results as normal ecosystem build-up make management likely to continue it for now.

The bio-based binder appears less central to the firm's machinery identity and had weaker public prominence than the home-page launches, so management has less reputational and strategic commitment tying it to the market.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is a highly visible, strongly announced machinery offering with partner-linked public commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes management very reluctant to withdraw it after only one year.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is close to the firm's engineering core and was presented on the home page as the latest product, so sunk development effort and public positioning support continued market commitment.
